visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a colorful 2D animation. A large brown turkey with a red wattle stands on a solid yellow ground against a black background. Three blue speech bubbles appear around it with white text. An animated young male character with dark blue hair and a black t-shirt appears in a small circular inset at the top left, then transitions to a full-screen appearance against the yellow background, gesturing with open palms and a friendly smile. (2) The scene shifts to a black background where different cartoon figures appear. A man in a red Turkish fez and vest holds a smaller bird, standing next to a man in a gray suit and bowler hat. Red arrows and text labels appear between them. This is followed by a rapid sequence of different male cartoon characters representing various nationalities (Indian, Arabic, Greek, Malaysian, Vietnamese) in traditional clothing, each accompanied by a flag and a speech bubble containing specific text. (3) A complex, monochromatic flowchart diagram with many nodes and connecting lines is displayed, centered on the screen under the text '来源: Max Shinn's blog'. The turkey character reappears, now with animated blue tear droplets on its face and a sad expression, while a speech bubble with text is shown. The background is a clean white and gray split. (4) The dark-haired male character returns, gesturing enthusiastically towards the viewer. Behind him, a large Turkish flag (red with a white crescent and star) is shown. Text labels appear below the flag, showing a change in spelling. The lighting is flat and consistent as typical for 2D animation, and the camera remains static throughout the sequences.
